senses.gloss: m. pl. (<cite ref="A02060"><he>אמר</he></cite>, v. Ges. H. Dict. s. v.; cmp.
units: ib. אֵימ׳) are not the festive Emurim (v. infra) the Lord’s, i.e. to be offered on the altar? Answ. מה שאמור ברגלים Emuré &c. means, whatever is consecrated as offering for festivals.—Esp. Emurim, Emurin, those portions of sacrifices offered on the altar.
<cite ref="Pesachim 71a:15">Pes. 71ᵃ</cite> <he>אֵימוּרֵי חגיגה וכ׳</he> the Emurim of the pilgrim’s feast offering.
